product: Pawn Stars clip 'BIG MONEY for RARE "ONE-IN-A-MILLION" HELMET (Season 17)' (YouTube id nSdQGgRKiWI, Pawn Stars official channel, Season 17 'Pawn V. Ferrari'). Chumlee buys; expert Bob Dodge (Artemis Testing Lab) tests with XRF; appraised $15,000; deal $10,000.

facts.fact: Seller found it at an estate sale with his sister; it reminded him of an old 1800s football helmet; he used to play football.
Seller hoped to sell for about $750 (on-screen tag $750).
Chumlee: doesn't know if it's worth $750, $7.50 or $7,000.
On-screen caption: classified as a Spangenhelm, German for 'metal strip helmet'.
Expert: appears to be an authentic Anglo-Saxon helmet; iron doesn't last 1,500 years, usually powder; probably preserved in a bog or river with little oxygen.
XRF test: 99.76% iron, traces of copper, zinc, chromium; carbon steel, as made 1,500 years ago.
Expert: 'one in a million', goosebumps; buyers would be museum or refined collector.
Appraisal $15,000. Chumlee: sad he didn't buy it for $750.
Negotiation: Chumlee $7,500 -> seller refuses, starts at $15,000 -> seller $11,000 -> Chumlee $9,500 -> seller $10,000 -> deal at $10,000.
Seller: had no idea it was worth that much; leaving with $10,000.
Articles confirm $10,000 final price; expert Bob Dodge, founder of Artemis Testing Lab; no record found of later resale.
